full_prompt_en: A square richly colored illustration presents a spring valley from a slightly raised viewpoint. A narrow ochre path begins at the lower center and winds past a bright turquoise stream, stone retaining walls, and small fenced fields toward a pink farmhouse in the right middle distance. Rolling hills form patchwork strips of lime, yellow green, and warm brown. Flowering trees dominate both sides: a deep rose-pink tree fills the left middle ground, a taller pale pink canopy reaches in from the upper right, and smaller coral, orange, teal, and yellow-green trees dot the slopes. A band of orange flowers brightens the lower-right foreground. Above the hills, enormous ivory and pale gray cumulus clouds billow across most of the upper frame, leaving vivid teal-blue gaps of sky. The clouds are drawn as crowded rounded lobes with visible concentric hatching and soft shadow pockets; the sky contains swirling brush-like marks. Individual leaves and petals are suggested by tightly packed strokes rather than photographic detail. Field rows, low walls, and fences add fine repeated lines to the lower half, while the serpentine path gives the busy image a clear route into depth. Bright even daylight lights the foliage and cloud tops; deeper green shadows sit beneath canopies and along stone walls. The palette feels saturated yet organized, with pink blossoms and blue water cutting through the dominant fresh greens. There are no prominent people or text. The whole illustration is exuberant but orderly, its patterned surfaces and broad clouds turning a simple country valley into a vivid celebration of spring.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形浓彩插画从略高视点展示春天山谷。一条窄赭黄小路从下方中央开始，绕过明亮绿松石色溪流、石砌挡墙和有篱笆的小田地，通向右侧中远处的粉色农舍。起伏山丘形成石灰绿、黄绿和暖棕色的拼布条块。盛花树木占据两侧：深玫红树填满左侧中景，更高的浅粉树冠从右上伸入，较小的珊瑚、橙、蓝绿与黄绿树点缀坡面。右下前景一条橙色花带增添亮色。山丘之上，巨大的象牙白与浅灰积云翻卷，占据上半部大部分，仅留鲜艳蓝绿色天空缝隙。云由拥挤的圆鼓小团组成，带可见的同心排线和柔和阴影凹处；天空也留有旋转的画笔痕。单片叶与花瓣由紧密聚集的笔触暗示，而非摄影般精细呈现。田垄、低墙和栅栏在下半部增加重复细线，蛇形小路则为繁忙画面提供清晰的纵深路线。明亮均匀的日光照亮树叶和云顶，较深绿色阴影留在树冠下和石墙边。调色饱和却有秩序，粉色花与蓝色水道穿过主导的新绿。没有突出的行人或文字。整幅插画热烈而整齐，花纹般的表面和宽阔云层把普通乡村山谷变成生动的春日欢庆。
style_prompt_en: Dense storybook illustration combines patterned color fields with highly worked, almost engraved surface marks. Saturated pink, fresh lime and olive greens, turquoise blue, and small orange accents sit below large sculpted ivory clouds. Rounded foliage is built from clustered short strokes; cloud lobes carry curved hatching and small shadow pockets; ground planes are organized into narrow repeated strips. Clear daylight keeps the hue separation vivid, while dark outlines and local shadows give textured forms weight. A winding light-toned line pulls the eye through richly detailed near and middle areas toward a compact distant focal point. The composition feels abundant and cheerful without losing its readable path through space.
style_prompt_zh: 密集童话书插画把图案化色块与近似版刻的精细表面笔痕结合。饱和粉色、新鲜石灰绿与橄榄绿、绿松石蓝及少量橙色点缀位于大片雕塑感象牙白云下。圆润叶团由短笔触簇拥堆成，云团带弯曲排线和小块阴影凹处，地面平面则组织成狭窄重复条带。清澈日光维持鲜明色相分离，深色线条和局部阴影赋予肌理形体重量。一条浅色蜿蜒线把视线穿过细节丰富的近中景，导向紧凑远处焦点。构图丰盛欢快，又保有可读的空间通道。
theme_en: A winding spring path through blooming trees and patchwork hills
theme_zh: 春日小路蜿蜒穿过繁花树木与拼布般的丘陵
name: Spring
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
